assertions.title: Job title selection shows/hides company email

steps.action: Navigate to React app at / then click Profile link to reach /start
steps.expected: Profile form loads with no Company Email field visible (no job title selected)
steps.observed: Profile form loaded. Company Email input element does not exist in the DOM when no management title is selected.

steps.action: Open Job Title dropdown and select 'General Manager'
steps.expected: Company Email field appears in the form
steps.observed: After selecting General Manager, snapshot shows 'textbox "Company Email *" [ref=e11]' - field is conditionally rendered by React.

steps.action: Open Job Title dropdown and select 'Sales Associate' (non-management)
steps.expected: Company Email field disappears from the form
steps.observed: After selecting Sales Associate, Company Email field is no longer present in the snapshot - React unmounts it.

steps.action: Click Save with all required fields empty
steps.expected: Validation errors appear for empty required fields and validation summary lists all errors
steps.observed: Validation summary alert (role=alert) appears: 'Please complete all required fields: Your name is required, Store name is required, Store location is required, Phone must have 10 digits, Invalid email format'. Individual field errors (p.text-sm.text-destructive) appear below each invalid field.

steps.action: Fill fields with invalid formats: phone='123', email='not-an-email', plusCode='INVALID_PLUS_CODE', hours='Mon-Fri 9-5'
steps.observed: 4 validation errors: 'Invalid Plus Code format (e.g., 849VCWC8+R9)', 'Phone must have 10 digits', 'Invalid email format', 'Include day names and times (e.g., Mon-Sat: 10AM-8PM)'. Validation summary lists all errors.

steps.action: Verify validation summary is visible as a destructive alert
steps.expected: Destructive alert with role=alert shows all error messages
steps.observed: Found 1 alert element with role='alert' and class containing 'destructive'. Text: 'Please complete all required fields: Phone must have 10 digits, Invalid email format, Include day names and times (e.g., Mon-Sat: 10AM-8PM), Invalid Plus Code format (e.g., 849VCWC8+R9)'

steps.action: Fill all required fields with valid data (Name='Jane Doe', Job Title='Sales Associate', Store Name='Citizen Company Store - Orlando', Location='the Orlando Premium Outlets', Phone='555-123-4567', Email='store@citizenwatchgroup.com', Hours='Mon-Sat: 10AM-8PM | Sun: 10AM-7PM') and click Save
steps.expected: Profile is saved to localStorage under 'userProfile' key
steps.observed: localStorage.getItem('userProfile') returns a JSON object with all fields. Phone was auto-formatted to '(555) 123-4567'. No validation errors.

steps.action: Navigate to Templates page (/), then back to Profile page (/start)
steps.expected: Form fields are pre-filled with saved values
steps.observed: All form fields show saved values: Name='Jane Doe', Job Title='Sales Associate', Store Name='Citizen Company Store - Orlando', Location='the Orlando Premium Outlets', Phone='(555) 123-4567', Email='store@citizenwatchgroup.com', Hours='Mon-Sat: 10AM-8PM | Sun: 10AM-7PM', Plus Code='CWCV+R9', Address='123 Main Street\nOrlando, FL 32819', Directions='Entrance E, near Polo Ralph Lauren'

frictions.description: Direct navigation to http://localhost:8080/start serves the old vanilla JS start.html instead of the React SPA. Must navigate to / first, then use React Router (click Profile link) to reach the React /start page. This is because Vite serves static HTML files for matching paths before the SPA client-side routing takes over.
frictions.resolution: Navigated to http://localhost:8080/ first (React root), then clicked the 'Profile' nav link to reach /start via React Router.

frictions.description: The Plus Code validation regex (/^[A-Z0-9]{2,4}\+[A-Z0-9]{2,3}$/i) is more restrictive than the example shown in the error message ('849VCWC8+R9' - which has 8 chars before the +). Had to use a shorter code ('CWCV+R9') to pass validation.
frictions.resolution: Used 'CWCV+R9' which matches the regex pattern (4 chars before +, 2 chars after).

summary: Tested 3 assertions: all 3 passed. VAL-PROFILE-002: Company Email field conditionally renders/hides based on management job title selection. VAL-PROFILE-003: Zod validation shows field-level errors and a destructive alert summary listing all errors including format validation for phone, email, plus code, and store hours. VAL-PROFILE-004: Profile saves to localStorage and pre-fills form on navigation back to the page.
